record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.original_question: Identify relatively simple sufficient conditions under which a Banach lattice algebra admits either a left regular representation or some faithful representation by regular operators that preserves finite suprema and infima, and in particular conditions that also address the Dedekind-complete target-space variant.

evidence.quote: In the absence of complete solutions to Problems 1 , 2 and 3 , identify relatively simple sufficient conditions for a Banach lattice algebra to have such representations.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Banach lattice algebra is a real Banach algebra $(A, \|\cdot\|, \cdot)$ that is simultaneously a Banach lattice with the same norm, such that the product of two positive elements is positive. For a Banach lattice $E$, let $L^r(E)$ denote the space of regular operators on $E$ (differences of positive operators); when $E$ is Dedekind complete, $L^r(E)$ is itself a Banach lattice algebra under the regular norm.

A lattice-algebra homomorphism from a Banach lattice algebra $A$ to $L^r(E)$ is an algebra homomorphism $\pi : A \to L^r(E)$ that also preserves finite suprema and infima (equivalently, is a Riesz homomorphism). The left regular representation of $A$ is the map $L : A \to L^r(A)$ defined by $L_a(b) = ab$, which is always a contractive algebra homomorphism but is not, in general, a lattice homomorphism.

Problem. Find relatively simple, verifiable sufficient conditions on a Banach lattice algebra $A$ that guarantee:

(a) the left regular representation $L : A \to L^r(A)$ is a lattice homomorphism (equivalently, preserves finite suprema and infima);

(b) there exists a Banach lattice $E$ and an injective lattice-algebra homomorphism $\pi : A \to L^r(E)$ (a faithful representation by regular operators preserving the lattice structure);

(c) the variant of (b) in which the target Banach lattice $E$ is additionally required to be Dedekind complete.

State and prove such sufficient conditions, ideally covering broad natural classes of Banach lattice algebras.
artifact.status_search_result: The underlying representation problems for Banach lattice algebras (faithful lattice-algebra representation into regular operators, including the Dedekind-complete target case) are explicitly stated as open in the recent literature on ordered Banach algebras. Indeed, two-dimensional unital Banach lattice algebras admitting no such faithful representation on any Dedekind complete vector lattice have been constructed, showing the question is delicate; no general simple sufficient conditions appear to be known.

status_evidence.title: Banach lattice algebras: some questions, but very few answers
status_evidence.snippet: It is open whether every Banach lattice algebra can be faithfully represented as a lattice and algebra in L^r(X) for some Dedekind complete Banach lattice X.
status_evidence.claim: The representation problem for Banach lattice algebras is open.

status_evidence.title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
status_evidence.snippet: In the absence of complete solutions, simple sufficient conditions are sought for these representations.
status_evidence.claim: The search for simple sufficient conditions is posed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Regular representations of Banach lattice algebras
status_evidence.snippet: There exist unital two-dimensional Banach lattice algebras with no faithful representation on any Dedekind complete vector lattice.
status_evidence.claim: Negative examples exist, showing the question is subtle.
